MyCaseOAuthCredential.title: MyCase Account
MyCaseOAuthCredential.x-credential-instructions: Connect an Advanced-tier MyCase account. MyCase support must provision your application's client credentials, registered callback URL and read/write resource permissions. The authorizing user needs permission to manage the firm's preferences, billing and payment options. The connection check reads your current staff account and does not prove write access.
